decision_reason: The extracted items preserve two unapproved architecture preferences and a March delivery reference, but no product or deliverable is identified. The undefined deliverable prevents a grounded PRD requirement from being written without invention. The architecture preferences also remain unresolved and cannot be treated as approved requirements or constraints. The March deadline can be preserved as stated without requiring an exact date.
